title: ProficiencyState
description: A life's proficiency state (AN-02b), the reply to a ProficiencyRequest. `levels` has all seven domains: level 0 to 3 and the XP in each. `version` is the total XP across domains; the writer (AN-04a) keeps it growing with every award, and this schema checks only that it is a non-negative integer. A life with no rows answers version 0 and seven zero levels. `sheet` is the adopted baseline (rule R-sheet); the NATS ACL, not this schema, sends it only to the Body role, never to an agent.

sheet_hash.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the canonical sheet JSON, computed by the writer (AN-04a); this schema checks only the shape.
